race.comment: BENEATH THE ROCK (8) progressive mare who savaged the line with the 58kg for a narrow second over 1250m at Canterbury. Key jockey change today and gives the impression she will be even stronger over this trip. Facing a tougher test and looks up to the task. PROBABILITY THEORY (3) building a strong winning CV but faces a few hurdles in this tougher race today. Stalked the speed and had the race in her keeping a long way from home over this course and distance. Has further improvement but place preferred from the draw with the 4.5kg weight rise. BESIDE THE OCEAN (6) deep into the campaign with mixed form this prep. Tempo suits and don't dismiss. ENAMORADA (2) smart mare who disappointed on resumption over 1200m at Randwick. Trip suits and worth noting she's undefeated second up. Claim helps. ALABAMA FOX (1) consistent mare hard fit for this with the claim.
